rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: reg_type=bilateral, bilateral_on_top=False, proj_filter_on=False, n_iter=30, learnable_alpha=True, alpha_init=0.1, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, n_bf=1, bf_multiscale=True, bf_sigmas=[0.8, 1.6, 3.2], bf_kernel=7, bf_sigma_r=0.02, bf_gain_init=0.0, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, batch_size=4, train_n=200, val_n=200, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, seed=42, rationale=iter-15 param_efficient breast -- LPD-STYLE LEARNED DUAL/COMBINATION block (last distinct arch lever, solver edit, 20-min budget). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: filtered-DC K=30 = 20-min CHAMPION 0.4345 @ 13p. Added PROX capacity does NOT help it: iter-13 (isotropic FoE +300p) hr 0.0, iter-14 (directional aniso +3p) hr 0.0 -- both FIGHT the filtered gradient because fbp(Rx-g) already does the reconstruction, leaving nothing for a prox to add. So the remaining lever is not a better PROX but a better way to COMBINE the DC correction across steps -- LPD's mechanism (0.68 on breast). (2) FAILURE MODE: the fixed x<-x-alpha*fbp(resid) update applies the SAME correction rule every step; it cannot learn to weight/route the correction using image context or cross-step memory. (3) ONE KNOB (architectural): lpd_on=True -- I added a minimal LPDCombine block: a weight-tied 2-layer 3x3 conv g(x, fbp_dc, mem)->update (3->W=4->1, 149 params) with a 1-ch primal MEMORY carried across the 30 steps; final layer ZERO-INIT => update==0 at init => x stays at the FBP init (safe seed, already clears baseline). per_step_alpha=True (the K alphas now scale the LEARNED update per step -- a real role, not the collapsed scalars of iter-7). Total ~= 149 (conv) + 30 (per-step alpha) + 12 (bilateral, UNUSED in LPD path) ~= 190 trainable. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a tiny learned operator that COMBINES the filtered-DC correction with image context + cross-step memory (LPD's mechanism) breaks past 0.4345 toward the LPD/VN regime, because it learns HOW to apply consistency (route/attenuate per-pixel + accumulate) rather than a fixed step -- the capacity that helps DC, unlike a prox smoother. (5) BUDGET: K=30 filtered + 1 tiny conv/step + 1 fbp/step, train_n=200, max_train_s=1080, --time=00:30:00, 200-val -> 20-min comparable. (6) SERIAL; iter-16: if LPD beats 0.4345, grow W / tune; if not, 0.4345 @ 13p is the honest comparable champion -> CONSOLIDATE the final report (Pareto + filtered-vs-adjoint-DC + capacity-doesnt-help-filtered-DC findings)., dc_mode=filtered, per_step_alpha=True, lpd_on=True, lpd_width=4, lpd_kernel=3, anisotropic_on_top=False
